title: A variety of
subtitle: 「各種各樣的」，究竟是哪一種多樣？
description: 「各種各樣的」，究竟是哪一種多樣？

words.note: 非常常見而精簡，表示有多種不同的人、事物或情況。
words.example: The museum displays various forms of traditional art.
words.exampleZh: 博物館展出各種形式的傳統藝術。

exercises.original: The museum displays a variety of traditional objects.
exercises.upgrade: The museum displays a variety of traditional objects.

exercises.original: The website provides a variety of tools for language learners.
exercises.upgrade: The website provides a variety of tools for language learners.

options.explanation: 自然地表示多種不同工具。

words.meaning: 一系列；多種；範圍廣泛的
words.note: 強調從一端到另一端有不同選項、類型或程度。
words.example: The course covers a range of topics from grammar to public speaking.
words.exampleZh: 這門課程涵蓋從文法到公開演講等多種主題。

exercises.original: The course covers a variety of topics from grammar to presentation skills.
exercises.upgrade: The course covers a variety of topics from grammar to presentation skills.

options.explanation: from ... to ... 明確帶出範圍。

exercises.original: The clinic offers a variety of services for children and adults.
exercises.upgrade: The clinic offers a variety of services for children and adults.

words.note: 直接而清楚地強調「種類不同」。
words.example: The market sells different kinds of fresh fruit.
words.exampleZh: 市場出售不同種類的新鮮水果。

exercises.original: The market sells a variety of fresh fruit.
exercises.upgrade: The market sells a variety of fresh fruit.

exercises.original: Children were shown a variety of musical instruments.
exercises.upgrade: Children were shown a variety of musical instruments.

words.note: 和 different kinds of 相似，但稍正式，常見於分類、技術、學術語境。
words.example: The study compared different types of renewable energy.
words.exampleZh: 研究比較了不同類型的可再生能源。

exercises.original: The study compared a variety of renewable energy systems.
exercises.upgrade: The study compared a variety of renewable energy systems.

exercises.original: Doctors use a variety of imaging techniques.
exercises.upgrade: Doctors use a variety of imaging techniques.

options.explanation: 正式地表達不同技術類型。

words.note: 強調差異性本身，表示組成成分彼此不同。
words.example: The city has a diverse population with many cultural backgrounds.
words.exampleZh: 這座城市人口多元，具有不同文化背景。

exercises.original: The school has students from a variety of cultural backgrounds.
exercises.upgrade: The school has students from a variety of cultural backgrounds.

options.explanation: 也可，但 diverse 更強調差異性。

exercises.original: The committee includes people with a variety of professional backgrounds.
exercises.upgrade: The committee includes people with a variety of professional backgrounds.

words.meaning: 廣泛多樣的；種類很多的
words.note: 比 a range of 更強，強調選項或種類的範圍很廣。
words.example: The library offers a wide range of digital resources.
words.exampleZh: 圖書館提供廣泛多樣的數碼資源。

exercises.original: The library provides a variety of resources, from basic textbooks to specialist databases.
exercises.upgrade: The library provides a variety of resources, from basic textbooks to specialist databases.

exercises.original: The centre offers a variety of activities for all age groups.
exercises.upgrade: The centre offers a variety of activities for all age groups.

words.meaning: 各式各樣的；一批混合的
words.note: 指多種不同東西混合在一起，常帶有「雜錦」的感覺。
words.example: The gift box contained an assortment of chocolates.
words.exampleZh: 禮盒內有各式各樣的朱古力。

exercises.original: The basket contained a variety of chocolates and sweets.
exercises.upgrade: The basket contained a variety of chocolates and sweets.

options.explanation: 也可，但更有「供選擇／精選」意味。

exercises.original: The drawer was filled with a variety of cables, batteries, and small tools.
exercises.upgrade: The drawer was filled with a variety of cables, batteries, and small tools.

options.explanation: 可理解，但不如 assortment 形象。

words.meaning: 一系列精選的；多種可選的
words.note: 表示從較大集合中挑選出來的一組不同選項。
words.example: The café offers a selection of teas from around the world.
words.exampleZh: 咖啡店提供多種來自世界各地的精選茶品。

exercises.original: The shop offers a variety of imported cheeses for customers to choose from.
exercises.upgrade: The shop offers a variety of imported cheeses for customers to choose from.

options.explanation: 可用，但少了「精選／供選」焦點。

exercises.original: The hotel serves a variety of desserts each evening.
exercises.upgrade: The hotel serves a variety of desserts each evening.

words.note: 較正式，表示多種東西以令人印象深刻的方式呈現。
words.example: The exhibition features an array of modern sculptures.
words.exampleZh: 展覽展出一系列多樣的現代雕塑。

exercises.original: The exhibition presents a variety of contemporary artworks.
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition presents a variety of contemporary artworks.

exercises.original: The conference featured a variety of speakers from different fields.
exercises.upgrade: The conference featured a variety of speakers from different fields.

words.note: 強調不同成分、類型或特質被混在一起。
words.example: The neighbourhood contains a mixture of old houses and modern apartments.
words.exampleZh: 這個社區混合了舊式房屋和現代公寓。

exercises.original: The area contains a variety of old buildings and modern apartments.
exercises.upgrade: The area contains a variety of old buildings and modern apartments.

options.explanation: 重點是兩類建築混合存在。

exercises.original: The course uses a variety of lectures, discussions, and practical exercises.
exercises.upgrade: The course uses a variety of lectures, discussions, and practical exercises.

options.explanation: 不同教學形式混合使用。

words.note: 比 a mixture of 更口語、更簡潔。
words.example: The audience was a mix of students, teachers, and local residents.
words.exampleZh: 觀眾由學生、老師和當地居民混合組成。

exercises.original: The audience included a variety of students, teachers, and parents.
exercises.upgrade: The audience included a variety of students, teachers, and parents.

options.explanation: 口語自然地表示群體混合。

exercises.original: The neighbourhood has a variety of shops, offices, and homes.
exercises.upgrade: The neighbourhood has a variety of shops, offices, and homes.

options.explanation: 適合不同用途場所混合。
也可，但不如 mix 強調共存混合。

words.note: 表示不只一個／一種，但不一定強調彼此差異很大。
words.example: The problem has multiple possible causes.
words.exampleZh: 這個問題可能有多個原因。

exercises.original: The problem may have a variety of causes.
exercises.upgrade: The problem may have a variety of causes.

options.explanation: 若要強調不同種類也可。

exercises.original: The software can be used on a variety of devices at the same time.
exercises.upgrade: The software can be used on a variety of devices at the same time.

options.explanation: 重點是同時使用多個裝置。
會更偏向不同種類裝置。
語氣不自然地強調很多。

words.note: 強調數量很多，而不是種類差異。
words.example: The report identified numerous examples of poor communication.
words.exampleZh: 報告找出了大量溝通不良的例子。

exercises.original: The report gives a variety of examples of communication failure.
exercises.upgrade: The report gives a variety of examples of communication failure.

options.explanation: 會改為強調例子種類不同。

exercises.original: Researchers identified a variety of problems during testing.
exercises.upgrade: Researchers identified a variety of problems during testing.

options.explanation: 如果語境重點是發現很多問題。
如果重點是問題類型不同也可。

words.meaning: 一整個光譜；一系列不同程度／立場
words.note: 強調不同項目位於一個連續範圍之中，常用於意見、能力、情緒、立場、顏色等。
words.example: The survey captured a spectrum of opinions on the issue.
words.exampleZh: 調查收集了對這個議題的一系列不同意見。

exercises.original: The discussion included a variety of opinions from strongly supportive to strongly critical.
exercises.upgrade: The discussion included a variety of opinions from strongly supportive to strongly critical.

options.explanation: 由支持到批評形成連續立場。
也可，但 spectrum 更突出連續尺度。

exercises.original: The patients showed a variety of responses, from mild discomfort to severe pain.
exercises.upgrade: The patients showed a variety of responses, from mild discomfort to severe pain.

options.explanation: 從輕到重形成連續程度。

falseSynonyms.zh: 很多不等於多樣 many 強調數量；a variety of 強調種類。 Many books = 很多本書。 A variety of books = 多種類型的書。
幾個不等於各種各樣 several 只表示數量多於兩三個，不表示種類彼此不同。
不同不一定等於多種 different 只表示不相同；若沒有複數結構，不一定表示「很多種類」。
語氣較口語，有時帶誇張 all kinds of 很常見，但通常更口語，有時表示「各式各樣，很多亂七八糟的」。
大量不等於多種類 lots of 主要強調數量多。
詞性不同 variety 是名詞；various 是形容詞。
意思接近但用法不同 various = 各種不同的。 varied = 內容本身具有變化、多樣性。
結構不同 通常說 a range of products，而不是 range products。
